title: Detached Windows PowerShell can exit before cleanup starts
body: Native Windows x64 and ARM64 CI on 2026-09-07 reproduced a silent uninstall failure: spawning PowerShell with detached:true and ignored stdio returned successfully, but the full installation remained even after a 60-second wait. Installer, MCP, hooks and upgrades had already passed, so this was not a missing Node runtime or hook failure. Node issue #51018 describes PowerShell terminating without an attached console and reports a conhost.exe --headless workaround. Preserve a startup acknowledgement and verify actual directory removal in native Windows tests; successful spawn or a longer sleep is not evidence that cleanup executed. Keep project runtimes outside the user-installation cleanup scope.

sources.note: Both native Windows jobs retained the installation after the bounded uninstall wait.
Upstream reproduction and discussion of detached PowerShell console requirements.
